name: Billiard
definition: straight pipe with a cylindrical bowl and a straight shank, the baseline shape.
notes: Glossary: cylindrical bowl, shank equal to bowl height; Dunhill code 03.

name: Bulldog
definition: pipe with an angular, tapering bowl and a diamond-section shank.
notes: Glossary: beveled forward-tilted bowl, diamond-shaped shank; matches definition.

name: Canadian
definition: pipe with a long oval shank and a short stem.
notes: Glossary: billiard-like, long oval shank, tapered bit; matches definition.

name: Freehand
definition: pipe shaped freely by the carver rather than to a classic shape family (R-33).
notes: Glossary: any shape not turned on a lathe, carved without fixed rules.

name: Kiseru [kiseru]
definition: Japanese long pipe with a small metal bowl and mouthpiece (regional kind, C11; provisional until attested in a second region).
notes: Bamboo tube, small silver/bronze bowl; sold in Japan (Kyoto maker); two Japanese sellers, region not yet second.

name: Hand pipe and chillum
definition: small dry pipe or straight conical pipe made for cannabis (shape axis not yet stated).
notes: Shop lists hand pipes; Wikipedia: chillum is straight conical pipe of clay or stone.

name: Hookah
definition: water pipe with a bowl, body, water base and one or more hoses, for shisha.
notes: Shop sells hookahs with bowls, hoses; page also names single and multi-hose hookahs.

name: Bong
definition: water pipe with a bowl and a tube, drawn through water, for dry material.
notes: Shop lists bongs and waterpipes; Wikipedia: water pipe, hookah similar but larger.

name: Dab rig
definition: water pipe made to vaporise concentrates on a heated nail or banger.
notes: Shop lists dab and oil rigs with banger and nail attachments.

name: Disposable vape [big puff]
definition: sealed vape sold prefilled and charged, used up and discarded.
notes: Shop lists Big Puff vapes as a kit type; no separate disposable category on page.

name: Refillable pod kit
definition: device with a battery body and refillable or replaceable pods.
notes: Shop lists pod kits, refillable and prefilled.

name: Box mod kit
definition: box-shaped battery device with a separate tank, adjustable output.
notes: Shop lists Box Mods and Sub-Ohm kits as kit types.

name: Heated-tobacco device
definition: device that heats tobacco sticks or capsules without burning them.
notes: IQOS ILUMA heats TEREA sticks by induction, no blade; shop has Heated Tobacco category.

name: Portable or desktop vaporizer
definition: device that vaporises dry herb or concentrate by heat.
notes: Storz & Bickel dry herb vaporizers, portable and tabletop; made in Germany.

name: Pocket lighter
definition: lighter carried on the person.
notes: Colibri lists lighters incl. Heritage Pocket; category page names Lighters generally; thin.

name: Table lighter
definition: lighter made to stand on a table.
notes: S.T. Dupont table lighters; Colibri has Desk Lighters category.

name: Pipe lighter
definition: lighter with a side flame for lighting a pipe bowl.
notes: Brebbia pipe lighter Bowl Flame; Colibri Pacific Air side-mounted soft angled flame.

name: Cigar lighter
definition: lighter made for lighting cigars (the torch or jet flame wording needs a fetched page).
notes: Colibri triple/double/single torch flame; Wikipedia: jet (torch) lighters typically used for cigars.

name: Rolling paper
definition: thin paper for hand-rolling a cigarette or joint; empty blunt wraps included.
notes: Shop lists rolling papers by brand and size; creaseless and cut-corner papers.

name: Grinder
definition: device with teeth for grinding herb or tobacco.
notes: Grinder guide: 2, 3 and 4-piece grinders with teeth designs.

name: Rolling machine
definition: hand device for rolling cigarettes or joints.
notes: Metal and plastic hand rolling machines; injectors for tubes listed apart.

name: Rolling tray
definition: tray made for rolling and holding material.
notes: Rolling trays, spinning and metal; hold pipes, bowls and tools.

name: Cigar cutter
definition: tool for cutting the cap of a cigar.
notes: Cutter types: guillotine, V-cutter, scissors; punch cutters also sold.

name: Ashtray
definition: receptacle for ash and stubs.
notes: Cigar ashtrays by Elie Bleu, Dunhill and design houses; some combined with cutter.

name: Cigarette case
definition: case for carrying cigarettes on the person.
notes: Cases for 7 to 20 cigarettes in metal or leather.

name: Cigar case
definition: case for carrying cigars on the person.
notes: 16 cases, 1 to 6 cigars; finger cases and soft cases; short-term carry.

name: Travel humidor
definition: portable humidified box for carrying cigars.
notes: Plastic travel humidors, 5 to 15 cigars (up to 80); humidifier included.

name: Tobacco pouch
definition: pouch for carrying loose or roll-your-own tobacco.
notes: Roll-your-own pouches in leather or canvas (Mestango, Guy Janot).

name: Vape coil
definition: replaceable heating coil for a vape tank or pod.
notes: Shop lists Vape Coils (MTL, mesh, brand-specific); coil is heating element in atomizer.

name: Vape tank
definition: refillable tank or clearomizer for a vape device.
notes: Shop accessories list tanks and glass tanks; clearomizer described.

name: Vape pen battery
definition: battery made for one vape pen or cartridge.
notes: Shop lists batteries and chargers under accessories; per-device match not shown.

name: Refillable pod
definition: empty pod for a pod device, filled by the user.
notes: Shop lists refillable pods by range (Elf Bar Refillable Pods, Xlim, Novo pods).

name: Hookah bowl
definition: bowl that holds shisha on a hookah, the phunnel included.
notes: Hookah Bowls category; types Phunnel, Egyptian, Turkish, Vortex; materials clay, glass, ceramic.

name: Hookah charcoal [hookah coals]
definition: charcoal made to heat shisha on a hookah.
notes: Hookah Charcoal category; coconut, natural, quick light; cubes, flats, hexagon.
